prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic nighttime street portrait of an adult blonde woman leaning naturally against a silver car. She has long straight blonde hair with bangs, natural skin texture, subtle arm tattoos, large hoop earrings, a wristwatch, and a small shoulder bag. Dress her in a fitted olive-green halter top with metal-ring details, a short denim mini skirt, and a black studded belt. Frame the scene at eye level with a confident relaxed expression, city streetlights, and blurred urban buildings behind her. Use direct camera flash with sharp highlights and deep shadows against the dark city background; let the directional flash subtly define her fitted fashion silhouette while retaining a candid nightlife aesthetic. Render in high-detail 4K, vertical 4:5, with realistic skin texture and controlled saturation.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

Preserve the blonde hair, olive halter top, denim mini skirt, silver car, urban night setting, and direct-flash treatment. Do not use celebrity/public-figure likeness.
